why.intro: The request names Track 1 for the splash screen.
why.menu: The request runs Track 2 from menu to level start.
why.credits: Credits is a menu card, so Track 2 holds.
why.card: The card comes before the level starts, so Track 2 continues.
why.level: Tracks 3–6 alternate per tile in Story and per run in Arcade.
why.pause: Pause ducks the level track so play resumes seamlessly.
why.ending: Run ends lead back to menus, so Track 2 returns.
why.finale: Megabot bookends the story: the intro theme crowns the monument.

ui-move.label: Cursor moves
ui-move.what: A menu cursor moves: arrows, stick, d-pad, WASD.
ui-move.why: Shortest select tick suits rapid cursor moves.

ui-ok.label: Confirm
ui-ok.what: A menu choice is confirmed: A, Space, Enter, a tap or a click.
ui-ok.why: Crisp short confirm keeps menus snappy.

ui-back.label: Back
ui-back.what: A menu goes back or closes: B, Shift, Esc on a page.

ui-pause.label: Pause opens
ui-pause.what: Play pauses: Esc, P, START or the pause chip.
ui-pause.why: Soft select marks the pause while the music ducks.

ui-start.label: START
ui-start.what: START on the intro screen opens the mode select.
ui-start.why: A distinct confirm opens the game.

ui-gate.label: Press any key
ui-gate.what: The first press on the intro screen unlocks audio; Track 1 starts.
ui-gate.why: Track 1 starting is the response to the press.

lunge.label: Dash
lunge.what: The dummy dashes (A). Spends a battery charge.
lunge.why: A short spring launch reads as a lunge.

jump.label: Jump
jump.what: The dummy jumps (B). A jump out of a dash is a long jump.
jump.why: The pack's jump sound matches the event directly.

jump.dash.label: Long jump, out of a dash
jump.dash.what: The dummy jumps (B). A jump out of a dash is a long jump.
jump.dash.why: A longer rise marks the long jump.

jump-land.label: Jump lands
jump-land.what: A jump lands on the ground.
jump-land.why: The pack's landing thud matches by name.

land.label: Drop lands
land.what: A drop from a walkway or deck lands, on a car or on the ground.
land.why: The same body thud covers every ground landing.

land.car.label: Onto a car roof
land.car.what: A drop from a walkway or deck lands, on a car or on the ground.
land.car.why: A metallic panel thunk sells a landing on a roof.

deck-drop.label: Drop off a deck
deck-drop.what: The dummy steps off a highway parapet or ledge.
deck-drop.why: The landing cue carries the drop; the 8.4 step-off stays light.

rail-jump.label: Over the rail
rail-jump.what: The dummy jumps a walkway rail.
rail-jump.why: A vault is a jump; it reuses the long-jump rise.

stair.label: Stairs
stair.what: The dummy starts up or down a stair.
stair.why: The pack has no footsteps; the procedural step suits stairs.

level.label: New level
level.what: The dummy reaches a new level: walkway, deck, roof.
level.why: The stair sound already marks the climb.

slip.label: Slip on water
slip.what: A dash is refused on a puddle.
slip.why: A wobble sells feet losing grip on water.

push.label: Push off a car
push.what: Arms: the dummy pushes off a car (Y).
push.why: Palms on a car panel make a flat metal thunk.

hitch.label: Hitch a car
hitch.what: The dummy grabs a passing car (X).
hitch.why: A clamp click reads as a grip that locks on.

sling.label: Sling off
sling.what: The dummy lets go of a hitched car with speed.
sling.why: A falling sweep sells the release at speed.

denied.label: Denied
denied.what: A move is refused: no charge, or not fitted yet.
denied.why: The name matches: a refused move.

denied.locked.label: Not fitted yet
denied.locked.what: A move is refused: no charge, or not fitted yet.
denied.locked.why: A system cancel says the part isn't fitted yet.

impact.label: Hit
impact.what: A car hits the dummy. Damage, points, the burst.
impact.why: Four hurt variants keep repeated combo hits fresh.

impact.big.label: A big hit
impact.big.what: A car hits the dummy. Damage, points, the burst.
impact.big.why: Crunch and blast give big hits weight.

impact.drop.label: A drop onto a car
impact.drop.what: A car hits the dummy. Damage, points, the burst.
impact.drop.why: A soft crumple suits a drop onto a car.

held.label: Chassis held
held.what: Story: a hit that misses the brief; the chassis holds at the floor.
held.why: A clamp click: the Corporation holds the chassis floor.

knock.label: Knock
knock.what: A car shoves the dummy without damage.
knock.why: The procedural shove scales with speed; hurt sounds mean damage.

touch-spent.label: Spent car
touch-spent.what: The dummy touches a spent car: no reward.
touch-spent.why: Spent cars pay nothing; silence teaches that.

writeoff.label: Write-off
writeoff.what: The chassis is written off: health reaches zero.
writeoff.why: The loudest explosion marks the biggest body beat.

chassis.label: New chassis
chassis.what: A chassis is issued: at a level's start, under the card, and after each write-off.
chassis.why: A clean beam-in suits Sinofuturist replacement stock.

chassis.start.label: At a level's start, under the level card
chassis.start.what: A chassis is issued: at a level's start, under the card, and after each write-off.
chassis.start.why: A level's first chassis beams in like every other; it plays the chassis cue.

part-break.label: Part breaks
part-break.why: A spark crackle: a part shorts out.

low-health.label: Low health
low-health.what: The chassis falls below audio.sfx.lowHealthAt of its maximum.
low-health.why: A city siren warns calmly without horror.

near-miss.label: Near-miss
near-miss.what: A fast car passes close without touching.
near-miss.why: The procedural whoosh tracks car speed; the pack has no pass-by.

miss.label: Dash misses
miss.what: A dash ends with no contact.
miss.why: The lunge already sounds; an empty dash earns nothing.

pickup.label: Cone picked up
pickup.what: The dummy picks up a cone (X).
pickup.why: A collect blip suits taking a cone.

drop.label: Cone set down
drop.what: The dummy sets a cone down.
drop.why: The pack has no plastic tap; the 8.4 tap suits a cone.

throw.label: Cone thrown
throw.why: A rising swoosh carries the cone's arc.

punt.label: Cone kicked
punt.what: The dummy walks into a cone and kicks it.
punt.why: The light procedural kick keeps a low-stakes action quiet.

cone-hit.label: Cone hit
cone-hit.what: A cone makes a car stop or crash: points.
cone-hit.why: A mid-size blast pays off the cone trap.

cone-struck.label: Car strikes a cone
cone-struck.what: A car runs into a cone.
cone-struck.why: The cone-hit sound carries the payoff; strikes would chatter.

cone-stop.label: Cone stops
cone-stop.why: Background cone settling would clutter traffic.

cone-rest.label: Cone at rest
cone-rest.why: Background cone settling would clutter traffic.

cone-release.label: Cone released
cone-release.what: Carried cones fall when the dummy is written off.

combo.label: Combo
combo.what: A hit extends a combo (two or more).
combo.why: Cycling collects build the combo count.

combo.max.label: At the combo cap (scoring.comboMax)
combo.max.what: A hit extends a combo (two or more).
combo.max.why: Two cycling powerups crown each capped hit without repeating.

combo-end.label: Combo banked
combo-end.what: The combo clock runs out; the combo is banked.
combo-end.why: A ledger chime: the combo is banked.

splash.label: Into the river
splash.what: The dummy falls into the river.
splash.why: A real splash matches a fall into the river.

rescued.label: River rescue
rescued.what: A drone recovers the chassis from the river.
rescued.why: Draining water as the drone lifts the chassis.

screen.label: Screen flip
screen.what: The view moves to a neighbouring tile.
screen.why: Flips are frequent; the 8.4 flip sits under the music.

honk.label: Honk
honk.what: A blocked car honks, at the dummy or at a cone.
honk.why: The pack has no horn; 8.4 honks keep each tier's voice.

honk.body.label: At the dummy; repeats while it blocks
honk.body.what: A blocked car honks, at the dummy or at a cone.
honk.body.why: The tier horn holds; the bark names the target.

skid.label: Skid
skid.what: A car skids on a puddle.
skid.why: slippery.wav runs 0.82 s; the procedural skid stays short.

unstick.label: Car reverses
unstick.what: A stuck car reverses or replans.
unstick.why: Replans are invisible; only reversing earns a sound.

unstick.reverse.label: Reversing beeps
unstick.reverse.what: A stuck car reverses or replans.
unstick.reverse.why: The 8.4 reversing beep is a real street cue.

learn-standoff.label: Model learns
learn-standoff.what: A car model learns to stop further back.
learn-standoff.why: A computer chirp: the model updates its data.

car-notice.label: Car notices you
car-notice.what: A car's headlights start to flash: it has noticed the dummy.
car-notice.why: Headlight flashes are the language; a sound would duplicate them.

car-brake.label: Car brakes
car-brake.what: A car's brake lights come on as it brakes for safety.
car-brake.why: Constant traffic chatter; brake lights carry it.

commit.label: Car commits
commit.what: A car commits to a manoeuvre.
commit.why: Internal traffic state; the player sees the move.

interrupt.label: Car interrupted
interrupt.why: Internal traffic state; constant chatter would mask the hits.

resume.label: Car resumes
resume.what: A car resumes after an interruption.
resume.why: Internal traffic state; constant chatter would mask the hits.

release.label: Car released
release.what: A car is released from a hold.
release.why: Internal traffic state; constant chatter would mask the hits.

ring.label: Roundabout lane
ring.what: A car changes ring on a roundabout.
ring.why: Lane changes are visual; sound would clutter the roundabout.

gridlock.label: Gridlock
gridlock.why: A deadpan uh-oh: the smart city stalls.

gridlock-clear.label: Gridlock clears
gridlock-clear.why: A quiet system confirm: traffic is restored.

admit.label: Car enters
admit.why: Cars enter constantly; the music carries the city.

exit.label: Car leaves
exit.why: Cars leave constantly; the music carries the city.

contact-ignored.label: Contact ignored
contact-ignored.why: It scores nothing, so silence keeps the feedback honest.

touch.label: Touch
touch.why: Zero-speed touches don't count; silence keeps the feedback honest.

drone-dispatch.label: Drone dispatched
drone-dispatch.what: A Corporation drone sets off: to clear a cone, or to the river.
drone-dispatch.why: A hovering whir: a Corporation drone, not an alien.

drone-dispatch.rescue.label: To the river
drone-dispatch.rescue.what: A Corporation drone sets off: to clear a cone, or to the river.
drone-dispatch.rescue.why: An official siren marks the rescue run.

drone-pickup.label: Drone lifts a cone
drone-pickup.why: A clamp click: the drone lifts the cone.

drone-drop.label: Drone sets a cone down
drone-drop.what: The drone sets the cone down.
drone-drop.why: The pickup frames the trip; the 8.4 tap closes it.

drop-in.label: Drone drop begins
drop-in.what: A level starts: a drone carries the dummy in.
drop-in.why: A motor hum carries the dummy into the level.

dropped-in.label: Dummy set down
dropped-in.what: The drone sets the dummy down; play starts.

story-enter.label: Tile in test
story-enter.what: The dummy is in the tile in test.
story-enter.why: The Corporation logs the tile in test.

story-count.label: Counted
story-count.what: A write-off counts toward the brief.

story-miss.label: Not counted
story-miss.why: A falling tone: the write-off doesn't count.

story-clear.label: Tile cleared
story-clear.why: The loudest powerup: the tile is cleared, louder than any combo tick.

story-gift.label: Credit gift
story-gift.what: Dummy Corporation gifts credits on arrival.

story-deliver.label: Delivery drone
story-deliver.what: A drone brings this tile's part.
story-deliver.why: A drone motor hum brings the part.

story-ferry.label: Ferry
story-ferry.what: A drone carries the dummy to the next tile.
story-ferry.why: The drone's hover carries the dummy onward.

story-ferried.label: Ferried
story-ferried.what: The ferry sets the dummy down on the next tile.
story-ferried.why: The next tile's entry sound marks the arrival.

story-fence.label: Fence
story-fence.what: The dummy meets a tile's fence.
story-fence.why: Blocked by name: the fence refuses entry.

gift.label: Gift screen
gift.what: A part falls, lands and is fitted: the gift screen.
gift.why: The loudest powerup: a part is fitted.

delivered.label: Delivery done
delivered.why: Fitting the part already closed the delivery.

unveil.label: Unveiling
unveil.what: The finale: the monument and its plaque.
unveil.why: A long ceremonial rise presents the monument.

unveil-lift.label: Cloth lifts
unveil-lift.what: The cloth comes off the monument.
unveil-lift.why: A sweeping vanish: the cloth comes off.

voyage.label: Voyage
voyage.what: A drone lifts the dummy toward the ship.
voyage.why: The drone's hover lifts the dummy to the ship.

voyage-end.label: At the ship
voyage-end.what: The dummy is set down at the ship: CERTIFIED.

shop-open.label: Workshop opens
shop-open.what: The workshop opens after a report.
shop-open.why: A menu blip opens the workshop.

purchase.label: Part fitted
purchase.what: A part is bought and fitted.
purchase.why: Equip by name: a part is bought and fitted.

purchase-denied.label: Cannot buy
purchase-denied.why: A short cancel refuses the sale.

shop-skip.label: Workshop skipped
shop-skip.what: Story: nothing to buy; the workshop is skipped.
shop-skip.why: Nothing to buy, so there's nothing to hear.

credit.label: Credits paid
credit.what: Credits are paid for a write-off.
credit.why: A coin collect: payroll for a write-off.

road-cleared.label: Road cleared
road-cleared.what: Arcade: the road's quota is met.
road-cleared.why: A long rising powerup: the met quota outranks any capped combo hit.

grade.label: Grade up
grade.what: Arcade: the grade rises; tougher chassis, denser traffic.
grade.why: A rising powerup: a tougher grade.

ending.label: Ending
ending.what: A run ends: Licensed, Certified, Failed test or Non-compliant.
ending.why: A deadpan readout: the Corporation files the report.

ending.win.label: Licensed or Certified
ending.win.what: A run ends: Licensed, Certified, Failed test or Non-compliant.
ending.win.why: The loudest powerup: Licensed or Certified ends bigger than any failed test.

ending.fail.label: Failed test or Non-compliant
ending.fail.what: A run ends: Licensed, Certified, Failed test or Non-compliant.
ending.fail.why: The longest lose sting: a failed test.

milestone.label: Milestone
milestone.what: An internal first (first hit, first combo).
milestone.why: It's an internal log the player never sees.

bark.label: Bark bubble
bark.what: A car's line appears in the message strip.
bark.why: A bubble pop: a car's line appears.

bark.shout.label: A shouted line
bark.shout.what: A car's line appears in the message strip.
bark.shout.why: Brighter chirps lift a shouted line.

intro-hit.label: Intro hit
intro-hit.what: The intro loop: the car meets the dummy.
intro-hit.why: Track 1 owns the intro; a looping hit would grate.

learned.label: Model returns
learned.what: A model that learned returns and says so (a bark).
learned.why: The bark sound already plays this line.

upgrade-seen.label: Upgrade seen
upgrade-seen.what: A car remarks on a new module (a bark).
upgrade-seen.why: The bark sound already plays this line.

part-seen.label: Broken part seen
part-seen.what: A car remarks on a broken part (a bark).
part-seen.why: The bark sound already plays this line.
